name: Test Cafe

guide.title: Test Cafe allergen guide
guide.source: menu.pdf, Test Cafe allergen guide (uploaded test document)

headline: Check the guide for oats and malt.
tips: The guide lists oats and barley malt as gluten cereals, so oat drinks and malted drinks are on the Avoid list.

notices.label: Cross-contact
notices.text: May contain traces of other allergens.

gaps: The guide says it may contain traces of other allergens but doesn't say whether that includes gluten.
The guide never claims any item is gluten free.
